sloka: सवैजयन्तास्तु गजा गजारोहप्रचोदिता: ।तरन्त: स्म प्रकाशन्ते सध्वजा इव पर्वता: ।। २.८९.१८ ।।
transliteration: savaijayantāstu gajā gajārohapracoditā: ।taranta: sma prakāśante sadhvajā iva parvatā: ।। 2.89.18 ।।

translations.english: Having reached the other bank, the men disembarked. While returning, the fisherfolk exhibited their craft of lovely formations.
